label: رسمي

angle.hook: Worlds comes to Japan: Riot confirms Nagoya hosts the 2027 Swiss Stage, the first Worlds stage in Japan
angle.why_now: Riot published the LoL Esports 2027 roadmap on 13 Nov 2026 (Japan press release 08:00 JST 14 Nov); tonight's Worlds 2026 final is not mentioned on the page, so not used
angle.what_it_means_here: first Worlds in Japan, MSI in Spain and the largest tournament Riot has produced in China; no Gulf angle, general esports news
angle.payoff: formats, qualification, dates, tickets and the Nagoya venue are not announced; Riot promises more in January

tried: Riot Worlds 2026 Final Trailer (lolesports YouTube 44oxy-v7CuY, 71 s): YouTube answers 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot' without cookies, not downloadable
Worlds 2026 Final Opening Ceremony Trailer (lolesports YouTube lWSL_yWAfLg): same block
lolesports.com roadmap page and Riot Japan press release on PR TIMES: images only, no video
Nagoya key art and First Stand: All In logo (official images) skipped: their burnt-in text would be cut at the 9:16 edges

Riot page and PR TIMES checked for a larger or text-free Nagoya image: same 1920x1080 art with burnt-in text; its castle area below the text is cropped to 9:16 and enlarged once (the render sees a 1080x1920 file)

decision_log: v4 (director fail on picture vs line): Nagoya line and cover sit on a 9:16 crop of Riot's own Nagoya Castle art below the burnt-in text (x 1070-1483, y 345-1080 of the 1920x1080 image, enlarged once with Lanczos to 1080x1920, no text cut, no crest), Seoul Arena only under the final line, Suwon under the QF/SF line, Valencia under MSI; First Stand: All In is in the X text and caption only (no official image without cut burnt-in text)
sound: our bed, stills have no sound, jingle on the end card
